name: col_substring
title: Substring(s) of an ANSI colored string

origin.description: substring() that keeps ANSI styles. The text is recycled to the longer of the index vectors.
origin.details: text is repeated with rep_len until it is as long as the longer index. The indices are then passed to col_substr. An empty text stays empty.
origin.example:
str <- paste(red("red"), "default", green("green"))
cat(col_substring(str, c(1, 3), c(5, 7)), sep="\n")

translation.description: substring() that keeps ANSI styles. The text is recycled to the longer of the index vectors.

arguments.name: text
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

translation.details: A single string is repeated when first or last is longer, the way rep_len repeats a length-1 character vector. The slices then follow col_substr.
translation.value: A string, or a list of strings.
